text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to rescind the existing parking prohibition on the west side of Albany Avenue, located between Bridgman Avenue and Davenport Road, across from Cawthra Playground, to provide additional parking for residents. This report also corrects an inconsistency between the one-hour maximum parking limit parking regulation posted on Albany Avenue and that listed in the Toronto Municipal Code.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking regulations outlined in Appendix A attached to the report (November 30, 2017) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District. 2. Enacted the parking regulations outlined in Appendix B attached to the report (November 30, 2017) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
